mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 69 degrees with clear skies by the Verona Area High School, and we have a Waxing Gibbous moon phase.
The Verona Police Department has published its latest report on calls for service from August 17 to August 24, including incidents ranging from traffic citations to arrests.

There is a lot to look forward to in Verona, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by trivia nights tomorrow and throughout the week, plus the downtown farmer's market this coming Tuesday.
Reviewing the weekly reports, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop where they discovered marijuana and cited a 28-year-old driver for possession.
Make sure to stop by for today's flavor, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, before they close their doors at 10 PM tonight.
